name: Selpercatinib
mechanism: Highly selective ATP-competitive RET inhibitor with activity against RET fusions and activating mutations, including gatekeeper V804 mutants, and with CNS penetration.
interactions: Acid-reducing agents reduce absorption (timing with food or acid suppressants matters). Avoid strong/moderate CYP3A inhibitors and inducers. Caution with QT-prolonging drugs.
resistance: RET solvent-front mutations (G810X), hinge mutations and bypass signalling (MET or KRAS amplification).
